Dad: What does Ruby’s grandfather tell you about school?
Eva: He says pupils used notebooks, not tablets.
Dad: Did you write about his first trip?
Eva: Yes, but Sam wrote the wrong year.
Dad: Was it nineteen sixty?
Eva: No, nineteen sixty-one. We asked Grandfather instead of guessing.
Dad: What did Jo think of the story?
Eva: She said it was clear, but two words needed explaining.
Dad: Did you add pictures?
Eva: There was already one family photo. We added a vocabulary list.
Dad: Who read it aloud?
Eva: Sam. That helped us find a sentence that was too long.
